items.headline: Bruno Fernandes hat-trick leads Manchester United to 5-2 victory over Ipswich Town
items.summary: Manchester United defeated Ipswich Town 5-2 at Old Trafford with Bruno Fernandes scoring a hat-trick and providing an assist as the team showed strong second-half performance.

items.headline: Bruno Fernandes named PFA Men's Player of the Year for 2024-25 season
items.summary: Bruno Fernandes received the Professional Footballers' Association's men's player of the year award after breaking a Premier League record with 21 assists last season.
